agent_note: Third-person retrospective. Only 4 event quotes -- BELOW the >=5 floor, so insufficient for a label on the event basis. All 4 are past. Beat tally (separate, non-pooled): 5 past / 0 present / 6 none across 11 dialogue quotes -- beats AGREE with the retrospective read and with the 4/4 past event split, so confidence high on the situation even though the event count abstains. Perfect correlation in this book: every beat-bearing dialogue quote is one that retained quotation marks (q09156, q09158, q09162, q09165, q09167); all 6 markless dialogue quotes are pure oratory with zero narrator narration. Book is heavily aphoristic/oratorical -- 7 gnomic, and several markless quotes could defensibly split gnomic-vs-dialogue either way (both are non-diagnostic, and all such quotes carry beat_tense none, so the choice does not move any tally).
